attchmntText: Avalon Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of Board Meeting relating to the Reclassification Request of Mr. Bhaskar Srinivasan'.
voiceSummary: Avalon Technologies Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the reclassification of Mr. Bhaskar Srinivasan and his Promoter Group from the Promoter category to the Public category. This decision was made during a meeting held on November 12, 2026. The approval is subject to necessary regulatory approvals under SEBI Listing Regulations. Mr. Bhaskar Srinivasan and associated trusts hold a total of 63,04,070 shares, representing 9.42% of the company. The group confirmed they hold less than 10% of voting rights, do not exercise control over the company, are not represented on the board, and are not key managerial persons. The reclassification request was based on the applicants' undertakings regarding their non-involvement in management and compliance with regulatory conditions.

attchmntText: Avalon Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Avalon Technologies Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved these results during a meeting on November 12, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue was INR 525 crore, representing a 37.4% year-over-year increase. Gross margin stood at 34.1%, while EBITDA was INR 66 crore with a margin of 12.6%. Profit after tax was INR 40 crore, up 59.5% from the previous year. The order book as of September 30, 2026, was INR 2,367 crore. The company announced a strategic joint venture with Zollner Elektronik AG and a preferential issue of warrants worth INR 425 crore, which is subject to shareholder approval at an Extraordinary General Meeting. Net working capital days improved to 120 days.

attchmntText: Avalon Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30,2026".
voiceSummary: Avalon Technologies Limited reported unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved these results on November 12, 2026. Revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 was INR 525.4 crore, up 37.4% year-on-year. Profit after tax for Q2 FY27 was INR 39.8 crore, up 59.5% year-on-year. For the half year, revenue was INR 1009.8 crore and PAT was INR 74.7 crore. The company signed an MOU with the Government of Tamil Nadu for 25 acres of land. Avalon Technologies and Zollner Elektronik AG formed a strategic joint venture. The Board approved a preferential issue of warrants worth INR 425 crore to Zollner Elektronik AG, subject to shareholders’ approval at an Extraordinary General Meeting. Net working capital days improved to 120 days in September 2026.

attchmntText: Avalon Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Avalon Technologies Limited board meeting on November 12, 2026, approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The board approved reclassifying promoter Bhaskar Srinivasan and his group from Promoter to Public category, subject to regulatory approvals. Shareholding details show a total of 63,04,070 shares, representing 9.42 percent. The board authorized a corporate guarantee of up to Rs. 55,00,00,000 for wholly owned subsidiary Avalon Technology and Services Private Limited. Another corporate guarantee of Rs. 50,50,00,000 was approved for wholly owned subsidiary ABV Electronics Inc from HDFC Bank Limited. The board also approved an investment of INR 11,00,00,000 in Revos Auto Tech Pte. Ltd., Singapore, via convertible notes. This investment is subject to definitive agreements and regulatory approvals.

attchmntText: Avalon Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Avalon Technologies Limited has intimated the schedule for an investor meet under SEBI regulations. The company will participate in the TRINITY ASIA 2026 Asia Investor Conference on 17.11.2026. The event runs from 9:00 AM to 04:00 PM Singapore time. The location is Singapore. The interaction is a physical group meet. The schedule is subject to change. Meetings may be group or one-on-one. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. The notice was issued by Company Secretary Ajay Shukla on November 11, 2026.
